questions.prompt: Which topic is explicitly listed in the syllabus coverage for “Creating Dependencies”?

questions.prompt: According to the worked example in “Creating Dependencies”, which result should the learner verify?
options: The app publishes itself to production and passes all tests automatically.
HTTP 500 is returned for every valid request.
Input validation and authorization are disabled by design.
questions.explanation: The worked example explicitly documents this expected result. Reproduce it locally in the listed environment before treating it as tested behavior.

questions.prompt: Which structure best supports maintainable request handling? (Creating Dependencies)
options: Use focused modules and reusable dependencies with managed resource lifecycles
Create a new global connection for each helper without cleanup
Store environment secrets directly in the source file
Call startup code manually inside every endpoint
questions.answer_key: Use focused modules and reusable dependencies with managed resource lifecycles
questions.explanation: Separation of concerns and explicit resource lifecycles reduce duplication and cleanup bugs.
